_comment: Opt-in publication vocabulary for THIS repo. The hunch package ships no term list — a list tuned to one project's strategy prose fires on another project's ordinary engineering writing. Patterns are JS regex source, matched case-insensitively against PROSE fields only (never ids, paths or evidence). Advisory: a match prints a warning naming the matched text, it never blocks a capture. Measured 2026-08-11: 5/6 recall against the six records the privacy pass pulled, 0 false positives across 256 published records.
